Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3987; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.
BiblicalUsage: Not to be tempted — God cannot be tempted with evil, James says, and he tempts no one. The word appears only here, guarding God's character at the exact point where suffering people are most tempted to blame him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this guards my view of God when life hurts: my trials never come from a God who is himself drawn toward evil.
